title: Replace Consonants: Incremental Debugging to Full Score
description: A stepwise debugging path with setbacks, then a clean convergence to passing public and private tests.
why_interesting: Good positive model: iterative testing and correction eventually produce a stable, fully correct submission.

timeline.text: Task: transform text by replacing consonants. The student begins with runtime errors.
Runtime issues reduce, but now logic mismatches dominate. This is a healthy shift: code runs, but behavior is still off.
A temporary relapse into runtime errors appears after edits. They seem to keep testing in small loops.
Wrong-answer phase: likely refining condition checks and character handling edge cases.
Public tests all pass. The core logic is now coherent.
Private tests also pass immediately after. That usually means the fix generalized, not just overfit samples.
Final submission reaches 100. A strong teaching example of incremental debugging discipline.
